name: partner-fit-disposition
instructions: Using only supplied partner facts, client ICP and restrictions, choose research_ready when verified identity and buyer overlap support internal opportunity planning; needs_evidence when facts are missing; hold when contact restrictions, conflicts or an unauthorized commercial model apply. This decision never authorizes outreach or partner acceptance.

options.research_ready: Supported identity and buyer overlap; eligible for internal planning only
options.needs_evidence: Relevant facts or terms are missing or unverified
options.hold: Restriction, conflicting outreach or commercial model outside authority
